title: How to Fix the Error using Intel Graphics Card
content: ### Objective Learn how to resolve launching error using Intel HD Graphics. ### Operation Since this crashing is due to a Graphic driver which is automatically updated by Microsoft Windows, please re-install the Intel graphics driver after deactivating "Windows Automatic Updates". ### Case 1 1\. Please input "gpedit.msc" on Search tool and execute it. 2\. Local Group Policy Editor ▶ Computer Configuration ▶ Administrative Templates ▶ Windows Components ▶ Windows Updates ▶ activate "Do not include drivers with Windows Update" ![0.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438341413785)※ Note: The option may not appear in the Window versions below. In this case, External Graphics card should be used. (Please refer to [Computer Specification](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358219834649)) Windows 7 Home Edition / Windows 10 Home Edition 3\. Device Manager ▶ Display Adapters ▶ Intel(R) HD Graphic ▶ Uninstall the device and driver software ▶ Reboot Windows ![1.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438341588761) 4\. Enter [Intel Support Page](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/intel-driver-support-assistant.html) and download and install the program of Intel® Driver & Support Assistant. 5\. Start scanning the driver. 6\. Download and Reinstall the driver of Intel(R) HD Graphics. 7\. Verify the "23.20.16.4901" version is installed correctly.![2.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438420736281) 8\. Please reboot Windows. 9\. If the Error is not resolved with Case 1, please proceed Case 2 below. ### Case 2 If the Error is not resolved with Case 1, please proceed Case 2. 1\. Please enter [Intel® Graphics Driver for Windows*](https://downloadcenter.intel.com/download/30196/Intel-Graphics-Driver-for-Windows-15-40-) and Download & Install the driver. 2\. Approve overwrite to the previous version during Installation. ![3.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438420990617)
content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions to resolve launching errors caused by Intel HD Graphics by reinstalling the graphic driver and adjusting Windows update settings.

title: Set Graphic Options (Above ver4.2.0)
content: ### Objective Change the default settings of the software menu according to user preference in User Settings. Upon restarting, the user settings of the software becomes the default settings. Shortcut keys, menus, graphic options, view controls, default files, font settings, and other miscellaneous properties can be set in User Settings. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶ Graphic Options Main Menu ▶ Settings/Preferences ▶ Preferences ▶ Graphic Options (ver 11) Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ Preferences ▶ Graphic Options (ver 2025.0) ### Operation 1. Follow the location indicated in the section above. 2. Adjust the settings as needed: Show Shadow | Shows or hides Avatar shadows by default. ---|--- Use Shader | Sets whether or not the shader is used. The shader makes the shade of objects appear smoother. Use Normal Map | Set the Normal Map usage to realistically express the 3D Seamlines and texture of the fabric. ANTIALISING | Sets how smooth the outlines of objects appear. As the number increases, the outlines become smoother and the rendering speed becomes slower. Use VBOs | Set the VBOs usage in order to improve the rendering speed. Image Resolution Setting (ver. 2025.0) | Set the maximum image resolution for rendering. The Images that exceed the set resolution are downscaled only during rendering to optimize performance. The higher the image resolution, the more memory Marvelous Designer requires to render and process.
content_description: Customize your software experience by adjusting default settings in User Settings to match your preferences for optimal performance and usability.

title: Skive

Move the scrollbar to adjust as desired. 4. Activate the Simulate. → The area of the internal shape is now being displayed softer as if it has been shaved down.

title: [Archive] Student License Policy (Prior to July 2026)
content: ⚠️ **Note:** This article outlines the old student license policy. For the newly updated policy (effective July 2026) including the **3-Month Free Trial** and **4-Year Eligibility** , please refer to our new guide: 👉[ **[New Student License Policy & Benefits]**](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/59985521768345-Marvelous-Designer-Student-License-Reorganization-4-Year-Usage-and-3-Month-Free-Benefit-Guide-updated-July-2026) ## **Expansion in student eligibility criteria, more students to enjoy the opportunity!** We are pleased to inform you of the recent expansion in student eligibility criteria under our updated student license policy. This revision was made to enhance accessibility to the benefits of learning Marvelous Designer, thereby allowing more students to enjoy the opportunity to learn and master this valuable software at their own pace. The revised policy provides students with an affordable pricing option and an extended duration of access, allowing ample time to explore and gain in-depth knowledge of the software. Our aim is to make it easier for students to access the benefits of Marvelous Designer, encouraging them to develop and master this valuable skill set. ## **[New Policy]** ## **License Option** * Student Yearly License: USD 99/Year (Not auto-renewal), up to 2 times within 4 years (since the first purchase) ## **Qualification** * University or college * A college or university that grants degrees after completing a regular course of study of at least two years (including 2-year public or private colleges and vocational schools) * Primary or secondary school * A licensed public or private primary, middle, or high school that provides regular education * Homeschool * Attendees of private CG-related courses * Certification of courses more than 3 months or curriculum schedule and tuition receipt is required _* Students will be asked to verify the student status through either school-issued email address or relevant documents on the purchase process._ _* If you have previously received a student discount, you can still benefit from the new student discount, which offers a 1-year license discount for two times. The eligibility criteria for the discount will remain the same during the checkout process._ ## **Methods of proving student qualifications** ## **Option 1. Use the email address issued by the school** If you enter your school email address, a verification email will be sent to that email address. Please verify your account through the verification email. ## **Option 2. Submit student verification documents** ## **[Institution of a student]** If you cannot verify through your school email address, you can receive a discount by submitting one of the following documents. The submitted document must indicate your name, the name of the educational institution, and the issued date. Sensitive information such as resident registration number or grades should be removed before submission. The document must have been issued within the last six months. * Student ID card * Enrollment certificate or academic transcript * Proof of tuition payment or statement ## **[Homeschooling student]** If you are a homeschool student, you can receive a discount by submitting one of the following documents. The submitted document must indicate your name, the name of the educational institution, and the issued date. Sensitive information such as resident registration number or amount should be removed before submission. * Copy of home school contract * Current membership ID of home school association * Proof of purchase of curriculum for current academy ## **[****Private CG-focused academic institution****]** If you are attending CG-related academic institutions, you can receive a discount by submitting one of the following documents. YouTube, private streaming broadcasts, and other informal online learning will not be qualified, and only official online or offline courses with existing curricula will be qualified. * Certificate of completion issued by formal institution * Course program schedule (at least 3 months) and tuition receipt ## **Notes** * Two-time purchase license (Not auto-renewed) * When you make your first purchase, your 'student status' will be activated. The 'student status' lasts for four years, and after that, you can purchase an additional license once. You will receive two benefits over a total of four years. * Once you have redeemed your student discount, you have the option to purchase a personal license. You can choose between monthly or yearly options for the personal license. * _**Refunds are not available under any circumstances. Please make your purchase carefully.**_ # **FAQ** Q. Where can I purchase a student license? You can purchase a student license on the pricing page by clicking on "[Buy Now](https://marvelousdesigner.com/pricing?type=academic)." Q. How do I verify my student eligibility? By clicking on the "[Get Started](https://marvelousdesigner.com/pricing?type=academic)" button for the student license, the school email verification process will begin. An authentication email will be sent through your school email, and you can proceed with authentication through the email. If you are unable to authenticate through your school email, please proceed with authentication through "Manual Input" or "Document Submission." Q. What payment methods are accepted? You can make payments using credit cards, debit cards, and PayPal. The payment method is a prepayment for a one-year license. Q. Can I cancel my student license subscription midway? You cannot cancel your subscription midway, as it is a prepayment for a one-year license. Please choose carefully when making your purchase. Q. Can I keep my existing subscription for the student license? If you are currently subscribed to the previous version of the student license, you can keep your existing subscription. You can also take advantage of the benefits of the updated student license after your current subscription has expired. Q. Can I cancel my current subscription and purchase a new student license? If you have a current subscription, you cannot purchase a new student license before the expiration date of your current subscription. You can check the expiration date on the [license page](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/license). You can purchase a new student license after the expiration date, but you will need to go through the student authentication process again. Q. How long is the validity period for the second discounted offer after purchasing a student license with the first discount offer? The validity period for the second discounted offer is four years from the date of purchase of the first discounted license. Please check your student authentication validity period on the "[My Account](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage)" section. Q. If I did not use the second discounted offer within the four-year validity period of the student authentication, can I receive the student discount again for a new purchase? If you did not use all the discounted offers within the validity period of the student authentication, you cannot receive additional discounts. Please check the validity period on the "[My Account](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage)" section and make sure to purchase within the validity period. Q. Does student license benefit also expire when the discount benefit expires? The four-year validity period only applies at the time of purchase. If you have purchased a student license prior to the expiration date, you may still use the license even after the expiration date has passed. For instance, if you purchase a license after applying the first discount offer on November 1, 2023, you may purchase the license with a second discounted offer until October 30, 2027, which is four years from the date of purchase of the first discounted license. Moreover, the license can be used until October 30, 2028. Q. How can I renew my Student License? Students are eligible to purchase a discounted license up to two times within a four-year window. Once these two terms have been completed, the student benefit concludes. To maintain uninterrupted access to Marvelous Designer, we recommend transitioning to a **Personal License**. Please visit our [pricing page](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/en/pricing?type=personal) to compare the benefits of our Monthly and Yearly personal plans.
content_description: This webpage provides essential information about the old student license policy for Marvelous Designer, while directing users to the updated policy effective July 2026, which includes expanded eligibility, a 3-month free trial, and affordable pricing options for students.

title: How to Prevent Marvelous Designer File Corruption
content:
**Objective** This article describes why Marvelous Designer project file .zprj and garment file .zpac are corrupted and how to prevent them.
``` Failed to read the Project file: Unzip error~
``` ![Screenshot 2023-01-27 165004.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438263659289) **Problem Situations** * When launching Marvelous Designer, get an error saying failed to read the project file. * When opening a project file saved on the computer, it says it is unreadable. * When trying to save the file, it says it can't be saved. * Opening the file takes a long time and eventually fails. * * * **Causes and Solutions** **Case 1.** **Disk Full... Actually** ![01 - Disk Full.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438263938329) * If disk space is insufficient during the process of designing and saving garments in Marvelous Designer, file corruption may actually occur. So make sure you have enough free space on your PC's drive. * We recommend that you have at least 20GB of free space to install and run Marvelous Designer. You can make free space by deleting or backing up unnecessary files. * **See also: [Marvelous Designer System Requirements](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358219834649)** **Case 2.** **Mechanical Malfunction and/or Connection Failure** ![02 - Mechanical-Malfunction.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438264140441) * File corruption may occur due to physical failure, disk error, or poor connection. * You can check disk status through the built-in disk management app or disk management utility on Windows and macOS. * In case of physical failure, contact your company's IT support department or the place of purchase. **Case 3.** **No Permission to File Read and Write** ![03 - No Permission.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438236469145) * All computer operating systems, including Windows and macOS, have permission to read/write your files. If you do not have or only have partial permissions to read/write, Marvelous Designer file corruption may occur. The following post explains how to gain read/write permissions for Marvelous Designer files on Windows and macOS. **[Disk access rights required when Marvelous Designer running](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358175269657)** * If you are a corporate customer, please contact your company's IT/Security department. **Case 4.** **Blocking File Read and Write, or Data Tampering by Security Apps** ![04 - Blocking file RW.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438252037529) * Certain security programs, such as antivirus and Internet communication monitoring tools, may restrict Internet access and file creation of software such as Marvelous Designer. **In their detailed settings, change the Marvelous Designer Internet access and file read/write settings to "Allow".** * In the case of enterprise companies, they often use stronger security solutions than those described above, and in some cases, the files themselves created by Marvelous Designer are tampered with. For corporate users, please contact your IT/Security department. **Case 5.** **Two or More Marvelous Designer Running Simultaneously** ![05 - Two or more CLOs Running.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438249085081) * If you use two or more Marvelous Designer at the same time, there is a possibility that the internal data of the Marvelous Designer project file may be lost or corrupted. * All you know that it's a good way to save file often. And **if you need to save the final result, save it with only one Marvelous Designer running.** **Case 6.** **External Storage Connection Failure** ![06 - External Storage.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438215098393) * File corruption may occur while reading or writing Marvelous Designer files on external storage such as USB stick or portable hard disk. Although these are convenient, in reality, physical detection failures and connection failures are relatively frequent. * When transferring files between an external device and your PC, it often appears that the file-transfer has been complete, but in reality, the all data has not been completely transferred. To check whether the file was completely transferred, simply compare the file size. * **In summary, allow plenty of time when exchanging files with external storage devices.** **Case7** **Network Drive or Cloud Sync Failure** ![07 - Network Drives.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438232214297) * If you use a NAS and various Internet cloud sync services, Marvelous Designer files may be corrupted during file transfer over the network. Additionally, cloud sync services may have problems that removing or damaging files on the local computer during the sync process. * If you use a cloud sync service, set it to sync only specific folders, excluding folders and directories referenced by the Marvelous Designer. **For example, disable syncing your Desktop and Documents folders.** * * * **Read More** **1** For example, the size of the zprj and zpac files, including Marvelous Designer basic t-shirt and basic avatar, is approximately 20MB. If your files are smaller than expected, it means the internal data may be corrupted. If your project file is less than 1MB in size, it cannot be recovered because all clothing data inside the file has been lost. **2** When recording animations of flashy, heavy garments, the project file size will be very large, and this animation recording data may be fragile in some user scenarios. If you are recording a long animation, dividing the entire scene into sections as shown below will help prevent file corruption. ![008_MD.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438300166681) * * * **File Recovery** If you would like to recover your file, please send us your problem file as is via **[Contact Us](https://marvelousdesigner.com/support/contact)**.
content_description: This webpage aims to inform users about the causes of corruption in Marvelous Designer project (.zprj) and garment (.zpac) files, along with preventive measures to avoid such issues.

title: Auto Sewing (Ver. 2025.0)
content: ### Objective Patterns are automatically sewn based on their placement on default avatars. ※Note: The available range of automatic sewing is as follows, * Top (T-shirts, Jackets, Jumpers, etc.)**** * Pants * Skirts ### Location Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ Auto Sewing 3D Toolbar ▶ Auto Sewing ### Operation 1\. Click the Arrangement Points of the Avatar to arrange the Pattern. * Since Auto Sewing is calculated based on the information provided from the Arrangement Points make sure to place patterns on the correct arrangement points. **※ Note:** correct Arrangement Points should be used based on the rules below. Otherwise, Auto Sewing may not work properly. Collar/ Band | Use Arrangement Points at the Avatar's neck. ---|--- Bodies | Use Arrangement Points on the Avatar's body. Sleeves | Use Arrangement Points at the Avatar's arm, the cuffs can be used either arm/wrist Arrangement Points. Bottom | Use Arrangement Points at the legs. ※Note: Be mindful of arranging the pieces to auto-sew correctly. \- If the belt length includes a placket that is placed over the zipper, arrange the placket piece. \- Trace the internal line of the side pocket along the side seams. \- If the pants' width is large, arrange front and back pattern pieces separately by using each of the arrangement points. 2\. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. * Choose Garment type. (Top, Pants, Skirt) * For Tops: choose Front type from "Openable, Partially Openable, or Closed" * For Tops with "Closed" selected: choose "Collar seam". (Auto, Center Front, or Back Left) * Click OK. * The arranged patterns are automatically sewn. **※ Note:** * This feature will only work with the Default Bounding Volumes provided by Marvelous Designer, custom Bounding volumes & arrangement points will not work. * If sewing has been applied prior to automatic sewing, it is maintained while the rest of the sewing lines are being additionally auto-sewn. * Darts and Pleats can be sewn automatically without arranging patterns. * For Pleats, automatic sewing is possible only when Internal Lines are defined by the fold direction of the Pleats. * (Make sure your sewing line has segment points dividing the line for this operation to function properly)
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to utilize the Auto Sewing feature in Marvelous Designer to automatically sew garment patterns based on their designated arrangement points on default avatars.

title: Express Cartoon
content: **Ver 2026.0** **** This feature allows for a unique cartoon-style look using fabric, 3D objects and avatar materials. ### **Workflow** 1. Select a fabric style or an avatar. 2. In the Property Editor, set Material ▶ Type ▶**Toon** 3. Adjust the displayed property values to achieve your desired style. #### ### **Options** **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Base Color** | **Color** | Corresponds to MToon’s Lit Color parameter, representing the original color visible when receiving 100% light. **Base Color Map** | The texture map used for the Base Color **Opacity** | **Opacity** | Transparency settings for the Base Color. The overall transparency value. **Opacity Map** | Apply Common UI for assigning Texture Maps / Adding Maps. **Shade** | **Color** | The RGB color of the shadow. **Shade Color Map** | A texture applied specifically to shadow areas. Often uses the same texture as the Base Color or is left empty. **Hardness** | The degree of sharpness of the shadow edges. **Shift** | Adjusts the threshold where shadows begin to form. Higher values result in larger shadow areas. **Emission** | **Color** | Configures the parts that glow self-luminously, unaffected by external lighting. The color that glows brightly even in dark environments. **Emission Map** | The texture map used for parts that glow in the dark. **MatCap** | **Color** | MatCap is a fake refelction effect. The color to be blended with the MatCap image. **Matcap Map** | A texture that stores pre-captured ambient lighting information, layering a glossy effect on the surface based on the camera's viewing angle. **Rim Light** | **Color** | Rim Light(Halo) effect formed on the inner edges of the character. **Fresnel Power** | Adjusts the thickness and sharpness of the rim light. Controls the falloff of the light-affected area. **Lift** | Adjusts the position offset of the rim light. **Outline** | **Mode** | Creates a border line to achieve a cartoon-like aesthetic. Mode is the method of generating the outline. **Outline Map** | A texture used for masking to prevent outlines from appearing on specific areas. **Color** | The color of the line. **Width (mm)** | The thickness of the line.
content_description: Discover how to create a unique cartoon-style aesthetic for your 3D objects and avatars using customizable fabric styles and advanced material settings.

title: 3D File (Alembic) Import/Export
content: ### Objective Import/Export the object, cache, normal, and animation data contained within an Alembic file (ver2.4.0). ### Location #### Import Alembic Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ Alembic #### Export Alembic Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Export ▶ Alembic (ver6.1) Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Export ▶ Alembic (HDF5) / Alembic (OGAWA) ### Operation #### Import Alembic 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ Alembic → The Open File window appears. 2. Select the desired file and click OK. → The Import Alembic window appears. 3. Select the settings as needed and click OK. → The Alembic file is imported based on the setting. Load Type | You can choose Open or Add. ---|--- Scale | Enter a number directly or select the desired values. Axis Conversion | Change the direction of each axis of the object. (ver. 2024.0) Option | Move Garment to Start Position | Navigates to the position of the start frame of the motion that imported the garment. Move Avatar & Garment to Start Position | Navigates to the position of the start frame of the motion that imported the outfit and avatar. Export Alembic 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Export ▶ Alembic (HDF5) / Alembic (OGAWA) → The Open File window appears. 2. Designate the file saving path and the file name. Then, click OK. → The Export Alembic window appears. 3. Select the settings as needed and click OK. → The file is exported as an Alembic file based on the setting. #### File | File Type (ver6.1) | Select a file type. ---|---|--- #### Object #### #### #### | Unweld Exports the Vertex (points of the mesh) of the parts of the pattern that are sewn together into one line into multiple objects. ※ Thickness exports for quad meshes available beginning version 2.3.0. (ver2.3.0). | Weld Combines the Vertex (points of the mesh) of the parts of the pattern that are sewn together into one line into one point. Weld Selected Pattern: Weld based on the sewing line that connects the selected patterns (ver2.3.0). Thin Ensures that the thickness will not be exported even if the rendering thickness value is increased beforehand. | Thick Exports a pattern with its rendering thickness values in its increased state. Merge Vertex by Proximity: Merge vertices across patterns by proximity Weld Turned Sewing Lines (ver 2026.0): Even when the Sewing Line Type is set to Turned, you can still merge vertices for export. Unified UV Coordinates: Exports all Garment Pattern texture data fit to UV Coordinates ranging from 0 to 1. Include Avatar Shape: Save the Avatar as part of the file. FPS | Sets the frame rate of the cache data. (below ver. 12.2) Basic | Scale the exported file by selecting the desired units or entering the percentage number. Animation | You can specify Entire Region or Play Region Only to export. Selecting the Current Frame menu allows you to export only the current frame. (ver. 2024.0) Color | You can export Strain or Stress as vertex color.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for importing and exporting Alembic files, detailing the necessary steps and settings to manage object, cache, normal, and animation data effectively.

title: CREATE CUSTOM BUTTON TEXTURE: Create Button Texture
content: ### Objective Create and apply custom textures to buttons in CLO in order to express various button styles. ※ Note: Adobe Photoshop is needed to create custom button texture. ### Operation 1. Download custom button texture templates (.psd) provided in the Library window: ※ Note: Choose your desired button design and download respective custom button texture file as needed. ![33.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438838867353) 2. Open downloaded .psd file in Adobe Photoshop. → The template is divided into three parts each representing front, back, and thread of the button. 3. Open a texture image to be embedded to the template. → The texture will open in a new tab in Adobe Photoshop. 4. Follow the path: Main Menu → Edit → Define Pattern → The selected texture will be added as a pattern in Adobe Photoshop. 5. In the Layer Window, select the desired layer to be painted with the defined pattern. The Layer Window is located along the right side of the Adobe Photoshop Window. 6. While the desired layer is selected, left click on the Paint tool and select the defined pattern → The selected layer will be painted with the chosen pattern. 7. Hide UV and Test layers, then save the image. ※ Note: Saving the image in .jpeg format is recommended.
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for creating and applying custom textures to buttons in CLO using Adobe Photoshop to enhance button styles.

title: What is the difference between Personal and Enterprise License?
content: There is a distinction based on the user's status. All users must comply with the "[Terms of Service](https://marvelousdesigner.com/terms)." Freelancers are allowed to use personal licenses, but all other companies (studios, game companies, research companies, etc.) must purchase enterprise licenses. If a corporate entity purchases personal licenses, access to the purchased Marvelous Designer license may be restricted or terminated without prior notice. If a personal license is purchased using a company's credit card or company email address, it may be considered as a purchase by a corporate customer.
content_description: This web page outlines the licensing requirements and restrictions for users of Marvelous Designer, emphasizing the distinction between freelancers and corporate entities in compliance with the Terms of Service.

title: Import and Export Preset
content: **New in MD 2025.1** **Add Preset** **Preset Options** **Supported File Formats** When Importing or Exporting 3D files, users can save their configured options as a preset for reuse. These preset files can also be shared, allowing users to distribute organizational standards and policies. #### #### Add Preset 1. Go to **File > Import/Export** to import 3D file. 2. Configure the desired options in the Import dialog. 3. Click the **Preset > ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/48920118220057)Add **button at the top of the dialog. 4. In the **Create Configuration** dialog, set the **Preset Path** and **Name**. 5. Click Save button to store the preset. The saved preset will then be selected in the Preset dropdown. * The saved preset can be selected during future imports to consistently apply the configured settings * Default Path: C:\Users\Public\Documents\MarvelousDesigner\Configuration\Preset\Import #### #### Preset Options **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Add** | Add a new preset. **Remove** | Delete the currently selected preset. **Open Folder** | Open the folder where the currently selected preset is saved. #### #### Supported File Formats Only 3D file formats are supported * OBJ, FBX, Alembic, USD * Maya Cache (MC, MCX), Point Cache 2, MDD Cache (Standard, Maya/3ds Max), OBJ Sequence **📝 Note:** * Each 3D file type uses its own dedicated JSON file and cannot be used with other types. * e.g., an Export FBX preset cannot be used for Export OBJ * Import and Export used separate dedicated JSON files. * e.g., an Import FBX preset cannot be used for Export FBX
content_description: Discover how to efficiently manage and share your 3D file import/export configurations with the new Preset feature in MD 2025.1.
